privacy.section1.body: This service handles file data on the server only to the extent needed to convert between images and EPUB. It is not intended for permanent storage, and processed data is not kept longer than operationally necessary.

privacy.section3.body: This service may use cookies or similar technologies to understand usage and to keep improving. You can disable them in your browser settings, but some features may not work correctly.
privacy.section3.title: 3. Use of cookies and similar technologies
